body.input: Which medical device companies opened an office in Norway in 2026?

response.content:
I was unable to find specific reports of medical device companies opening a new office in Norway in 2026.

The closest relevant development I found is that **Rosti Group** acquired **Alvi Group** in November 2026, which added Norway to Rosti's international footprint through Alvi's existing operational facilities. Rosti provides contract manufacturing services for medical device original equipment manufacturers. However, this was an acquisition of existing facilities rather than a new office opening.

Beyond that, no specific announcements of medical device companies opening new offices in Norway during 2026 were identified in available sources.

The fact describes the addition of Norway as a result of acquiring existing operational facilities, not the establishment of a new office.
Since no other facts mention any medical device company opening a new office in Norway in 2026, the answer correctly states that no specific reports of such office openings were found.

# Rosti acquires Alvi to strengthen medical device manufacturing

The deal brings roughly 400 Alvi personnel and operational facilities across China, Norway, Poland, and Sweden into the acquiring group.

Salong Debbarma November 10, 2026

Share

 Copy Link
 Share on X
 Share on Linkedin
 Share on Facebook

  

Rosti Group provides design-to-delivery contract manufacturing services for original equipment manufacturers across medical sectors. Credit: Rosti Group.

Contract manufacturing and plastic injection moulding company Rosti Group has acquired Alvi Group to strengthen its manufacturing provision for medical devices.

Following the acquisition, Rosti now has a combined corporate revenue of approximately €450m ($503.4m). [...] Rosti now employs around 3,000 personnel globally, while maintaining corporate sustainability reporting directive (CSRD)-aligned sustainability practices across its combined network.

Rosti Group CEO Jonas Persson said: “This acquisition strengthens Rosti. We’re gaining proven capabilities and experienced teams in plastics manufacturing, expanding our offer in Sweden, Poland and China, while adding Norway to our footprint.

“Combined with our existing operations across US, Europe and Asia, we can now serve our customers even more comprehensively. The integration of Alvi into Rosti Group allows us to leverage our scale and expertise across new and different markets.” [...] ### Go deeper with GlobalData

The transaction, the terms of which were not publicly disclosed, brings nearly 400 Alvi personnel and operational facilities across China, Norway, Poland, and Sweden into the acquiring group. It also adds Norway to Rosti’s international footprint and broadens its capabilities across industrial manufacturing.
